## Acid Trap
Chave: `resources.assets:2545532` — GUID: `c2ae71a3-938b-4960-8677-afa374d05527`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0

### Texto original
You come across a statue of a snake carved from what appeares to be solid stone. Its gemstone eyes gleam dangerously, as a cloud of greenish fumes billow forth from its maw. An acrid, burning smell fills the air, stinging your nostrils forcing you back.

Someone with the constitution to weather the poisonous fumes might be able to jam the deadly <incr><b><green>Acid Trap</green></b></incr>.

## Alchemist's Workbench
Chave: `resources.assets:2545533` — GUID: `6172b8ad-6e95-43e8-adf8-9c16b209974f`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/alchemist's workbench — SHA objeto: `cfb29209fae7a2ed08983392649cd8dda8021d458a6ba51a7532971bc6abf738`

### Texto original
You stumble across an ornate table cluttered with scrolls, flasks, and various arcane implements - clearly an <b><blue><incr>Alchemist's Workbench</incr></blue></b>. The air is thick with the scent of ancient herbs and lingering magic, a tantalizing aroma for any adventurer.

On the table lay an open scroll, the elegant elvish script detailing recipes for various magical potions. The instructions, although intricate, are clear enough.

## Archery Competition
Chave: `resources.assets:2545535` — GUID: `053565ee-baf0-4218-a394-c9058037e80f`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/archery competition — SHA objeto: `40deaad2cfefd75220dcba6201b25c2a8c55281336a1d4eb8491279fe121cca7`

### Texto original
In a forest clearing, an unexpected challenge has been set by an even more unexpected challenger. <green><b><incr>Gobin Hood</incr></b></green>, a goblin of monstrous strength, challenges your intrepid band of adventurers to an unconventional test of archery.

"Not the usual sissy elf game," <green><b><incr>Gobin Hood</incr></b></green> growls, hefting his crude bow made from gnarled ironwood. "We ain't aiming for some painted dot. We're smashing through the target!"

The target mentioned is no simple slab of wood, but a formidable barricade, several planks thick, far more robust than any normal target.

## Bonefire
Chave: `resources.assets:2545548` — GUID: `b2cbffb6-4ee2-48f5-9c10-4fc110764f3f`

### Texto original
A ghastly pyre dances with unnatural, green flames. It is a bonfire, fueled by an ominous collection of human bones that emits an eerie glow. As you watch the flickering flames, a wave of unnatural weariness descends upon you. The fire seems to burn not just with bones, but with the very life-force of those who gaze upon it...

### Texto original
Resting upon a wooden table is a flask filled with an iridescent potion, its glow a beacon amidst the surrounding gloom. Beside it, you find a tattered note scrawled in a spidery script: "Blast! Can't see further than my own nose, Yet, I feel an undeniable surge of energy coursing through my veins. I'm blind as a bat, but I've the strength of a ogre!"

## Carved Monolith
Chave: `resources.assets:2545555` — GUID: `9c907851-1c3e-4d43-9286-96559cbfda7f`

### Texto original
A monolith, a colossal structure, hewn from pure obsidian towers over you. Carved into the heart of the obsidian is a single rune, a shape foreign to your knowledge. It shimmers with an emerald glow, casting an eerie radiance that pulses with arcane energy. The rune's light dances over the monolith, flowing like an ethereal stream over the obsidian surface, the sheer magic within it making the air buzz with power.

Tall and gleaming, a gong stands as a sentinel of forgotten times, its radiant surface reflecting the shimmering sunlight. Forged with ancient craftsmanship and bearing the weight of forgotten legends, it calls out to those who dare to strike its resplendent surface. Its mighty clang reverberates through the mountains, carrying a challenge to all who have the audacity to accept. The call is irresistible, a siren's song beckoning warriors from near and far to test their mettle.

Chave: `resources.assets:2545562` — GUID: `cc9cedb8-b215-4800-b84e-f96c1993fcd3`

### Texto original
You stumble upon a <indigo><b><incr>Cursed Chest</incr></b></indigo>, a grotesque artifact held together by rotting wood and bound by the spine of some poor, unfortunate creature.

The chest exudes an aura of decay, as if its very existence was tainted by a foul presence. The wood, once sturdy and proud, now warped and decayed, bares the weight of forgotten sorrows. Its presence alone foretells a tale of woe and warns of the dangers that lay within.

## Cursed Clock
Chave: `resources.assets:2545563` — GUID: `6b49fc7c-abec-4c0c-8cba-3742c795ec50`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0

### Texto original
The dull chime of an old grandfather clock draws your attention. With every swing of its pendulum, the clock emits a soft, hypnotic tick—a melody that holds the power to ensnare the senses and entrap the unwary. You feel a supernatural force washing over you, like a thick fog seeping into your consciousness. Your eyes fixate upon the pendulum's graceful arc, your mind falling under its subtle spell.

Minutes turn into hours, hours into days, as you stand entranced before the <indigo><b><incr>Cursed Clock</incr></b></indigo>.

## Dark Discoveries
Chave: `resources.assets:2545572` — GUID: `385b8352-0189-42e2-905c-ee6b0dae867e`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/dark discoveries — SHA objeto: `dd248b24fbb6f799f526d1300e8a2ac673885d00819a5335c376c5bda8f9f532`

### Texto original
The powerful and tormented figure of <blue><b><incr>The Necromancer</incr></b></blue> greets you:

"Brave souls, I beseech you. I stand before you, burdened by the consequences of my actions. In my pursuit of knowledge and power, a few of my undead experiments have escaped my control, their wretched forms bloated with the tormented souls of the damned. I require aid to release those souls so I may reclaim them."

"I offer more than a mere reward for your service. I possess knowledge, ancient and profound, that can unlock the mysteries of the arcane. With my guidance, you shall wield powers beyond mortal comprehension."

### Resultados possíveis (texto autoral)

## Desecrated Statue of the First Mountain King
Chave: `resources.assets:2545576` — GUID: `31c21c13-d1fb-4be8-9d45-299dbad44e9e`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/desecrated statue of the first mountain king — SHA objeto: `23f9c8d8d8927b82bd66e003ce2effed4778f4e47553242a3914521f956c3023`

### Texto original
In the heart of these ancient ruins, you stumble upon a sight as awe-inspiring as it is tragic - a statue of a dwarven king, sculpted with meticulous precision from pure gold. Once resplendent and majestic, the statue is now a hollow echo of its former grandeur. It bares the telltale signs of looting, the handiwork of goblins all too clear in the crude scars and scratches that marred its surface.

The once-noble features of the dwarven king were missing, the statue's head severed from its body. It lay at the base of the statue, its golden eyes gazing up at the heroes with a strange sort of melancholy. As you approach, a voice echoes out from the decapitated head:

"Well, well, what have we here? A ragtag bunch of adventurers? Come to witness the sorry state of this once majestic form? 'Tis I, the great Mountain King, turned into naught but a pile of rubble by those wretched goblins!"

"I demand justice, I say!"

"Retrieve me, in all my golden glory, and return me to the halls of my ancestors. Let those goblins quake with fear at the sight of the First Mountain King once more!"

## Disturbing Diner
Chave: `resources.assets:2545577` — GUID: `06f45978-e4ec-44bf-b216-cd3c84686572`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/disturbing diner — SHA objeto: `8e803f5d3d720c229dd6534562419f95def8db73f92af0ba1cae62f2ec6f8401`

### Texto original
There stands a man before you as chilling as the frosty winds of Frostwrought Mountain. A towering figure, with a burlap sack pulled down tightly over his head and a horrifying apron, spotted with deep crimson stains, wrapped around his broad chest.

"Good eve," he rasps, his voice like gravel and smoke. "Are you in need of sustenance?"

The man extends a gnarled hand, presenting a trio of dishes, each more horrifying than the last.

First, a bubbling, steaming cauldron of a soup, its murky surface breaking to reveal human hands, fingers curled as though grasping for escape. Next, a plate of what seems to be oversized cockroaches, their bodies crisp and their wings crackling as if recently deep-fried. And finally, a platter bearing a single, massive, dark purple tentacle. It twitches, even in its cooked state, muscles rippling under its suckered skin, making the dish appear as though it was still alive.

### Resultados possíveis (texto autoral)
The man remains silent, watching with disturbing patience for you to choose.

#### Ação 1: Success — RollLimit 0
The initial crunch of the shell is followed by a burst of flavors, wildly contrasting the horrifying appearance of the dish. There is a nutty sweetness to it, counteracted by a savory note that is strangely pleasing. The texture is akin to a perfectly roasted poultry, the shell providing a sharp, crispy contrast to the succulent flesh within.

### Opção 2: Hand Soup
A dark, brooding broth, the soup has an ethereal quality, swirls of steam dance above it. Peeking out of the opaque depths are the human hands, boiled down to the bone, the eerie spectacle almost hypnotic.

#### Ação 1: Success — RollLimit 0
The broth is rich and hearty, filled with flavors of earthy roots, a hint of the sea, and something slightly metallic. It is, to your surprise, pleasantly palatable, offering an unusual array of tastes and sensations. The bones themselves are another experience entirely. Crunchy and delicate, they give way easily, revealing the tenderness of the marrow within. It is soft and rich, with a creamy, almost buttery texture that belied its grim origins.

### Opção 3: Twitching Tentacle
The tentacle's slick surface is adorned with rows of suckers. Every few seconds, it twitches, the muscle memory of the creature it once belonged to asserting itself in death.

#### Ação 1: Success — RollLimit 0
It is chewy, the texture similar to calamari but somehow more intense, more primal. The flavor that exploded in your mouth is unexpectedly delicate – an amalgamation of the sea and the earth, a unique savoriness tinged with a briny sweetness.

The twitching sensation is a bit disconcerting but, remarkably, it doesn't detract from the experience. It felt almost alive in your mouth, a strange dance that adds an unexpected layer of texture to the meal.

## Dwarven Sentry Wall
Chave: `resources.assets:2545579` — GUID: `7b6c58f0-2671-429e-9807-780a7695d9d8`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/dwarven sentry wall — SHA objeto: `0da4075b0819d99283d1d07a5f042453636e05576af93d244d5be7a6419060c3`

### Texto original
In the flickering light, you behold a colossal barrier, a monument to the dwarves' rocky resilience. Hewn directly from solid bedrock and crafted into the stone visage of a bearded dwarf. A gruff voice calls out at your approach:

"Aye. And who might ye be? Ye look no dwarf to me."

Dwarven sentries are notorious for their lack of hospitality to those not of their own. Best to play the part.

Deep within the winding tunnels of the ancient dwarven halls, you discover a chamber of remarkable grandeur. Its heart holds a dwarven sarcophagus, a marvel of stonemasonry that commands your awe and reverence. Intricately chiseled from solid granite, it is adorned with a cascade of dwarven runes, their angular forms whispering tales of valor and lineage etched into the cold stone.

## Edwin's Demise
Chave: `resources.assets:2545582` — GUID: `4af726e7-657e-403a-883b-e3221fdd700c`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/edwin's demise — SHA objeto: `4323c60557614e358cbca64276e6c899c4b7854a34fb0381d4d17a5162d70901`

### Texto original
 On a worn table lays a spellbook, its pages yellowed with age, its spine fragile and cracked. Its cover was worn and tattered, suggestive of the countless fingers that had turned its pages, and the innumerable years it has weathered. Parts of the book had been damaged or lost over time, leaving behind an incomplete narrative, like a puzzle missing several pieces:

"---- there are tales woven with the threads of glory and tragedy alike. Such is the tale of Edwin an unremarkable lad, a mere acolyte of the most basic magics. His journey to fame was as surprising as it was sudden ---- enchantment granted him immense power by ---- a steep price that Edwin willingly paid for the allure of newfound abilities ---- His demonstrations of power quickly catapulted him into fame, attracting vast crowds eager to witness his spectacular displays of magic. Yet ---- The climax of Edwin's tragic tale occurred on a grand stage where he attempted to manifest an impressive display ---- In summary, Edwin's tale is a stark warning about the dangers of unchecked ambition and the dire consequences of misusing power. Infact, only a fool ----"

The rest of the page is illegible. However, instructions to cast Edwin's Enchantment are perfectly clear on the page beside it.

## Elder Tree
Chave: `resources.assets:2545583` — GUID: `2779cca5-013a-4bbc-ba32-e7d25ef7c8b7`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/elder tree — SHA objeto: `7726757770037320fd782091ff9422fa4b42c91fb292e1668b7529300a6978c1`

### Texto original
A massive <green><b><incr>Elder Tree</incr></b></green> grows here. Its giant body formed not only of wood but of living stone and ore. All around it life seems to flourish as if it were the very heart of the forest.

You stumble upon an entity as old as time itself: the <green><b><incr>Elder Tree</incr></b></green>. It stands regal and magnificent, its massive trunk adorned with the etchings of time, its gnarled boughs stretching out like the arms of a benevolent giant.

The air around it hums with an ancient magic, a soothing hum that permeates your senses and seems to soften the edges of the world. A sense of profound tranquility seems to blanket the area around the tree, a bubble of peace amidst the trials of your journey. The tree's aura washes over you, melting away your fatigue, soothing your aches, and calming your mind.

## Enchanted Obelisk
Chave: `resources.assets:2545585` — GUID: `36c51484-b50b-4627-a9a7-64d221a22f1a`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0

### Texto original
Rising from the earth like the tooth of some gargantuan beast, an obelisk crafted entirely from limestone, ancient and weathered stands proud and defiant. 

Upon the weather-beaten stone, a single white rune is etched, glowing softly in the dying light of the day. Its luminescence pulsing gently, in rhythm with the heart of the world. Even from a distance, you can sense its potent magic, a beacon drawing you towards it.

## Enchanted Pumpkin Patch
Chave: `resources.assets:2545587` — GUID: `3bda807e-075d-45e3-afe7-b9d0f9d4b34c`

### Texto original
You stumble upon an unlikely sight: an <orange><b><incr>Enchanted Pumpkin Patch</incr></b></orange>, nestled amidst the wilderness. Vibrant pumpkins of all sizes dot the landscape, their rich orange hue glow like embers in the creeping shadows. At the heart of the patch, keeping a silent vigil, stands a towering scarecrow.

Its form is grotesquely exaggerated, angular and ominous under the light, its eyes twin points of baleful luminescence in its shadowed face. Despite its ghastly appearance, a strange, palpable magic thrums in the air around it, tying it to the very life force of the pumpkin patch.

## Entangled Boar
Chave: `resources.assets:2545589` — GUID: `ad2b9f6c-46c8-4e66-ae0d-8825c3948d41`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/entangled boar — SHA objeto: `31dde506c7176062328d57a18261c88ca218d33aa437a5783d92b39115b50703`

### Texto original
A <green><b><incr>Wild Boar</incr></b></green>, powerfully built and grim-eyed, is caught in a thorny snare. The thick Bristlethorn, is tough as twisted iron and studded with wicked thorns that dig deep into the boar's hide.

Every movement the boar makes only seems to make the situation worse. The thorns bite deeper into its flesh, drawing forth beads of crimson that seep into the rich, damp earth. It thrashes and grunts in raw, unfiltered fear and pain, its eyes wild with the primitive instinct of a creature trapped and in distress.

#### Ação 1: Success — RollLimit 11
With a swift, precise stroke, you cut through the thorny vine. The tension in the boar's body eases as the vine's grip lessens. The boar stumbles, then rights itself, its eyes wide.

The boar grunts, a low, rumbling sound that seems almost... grateful. You turn to leave, but a rustle behind you gives you pause.


Turning, you find the boar following you, its eyes fixed on you with something akin to loyalty. It seems the beast, in its own wild, untamed way, has pledged its gratitude to you. You can't help but smile, feeling a strange sense of companionship.

## Eruption!
Chave: `resources.assets:2545590` — GUID: `db1ccfd4-c6d4-4dc1-9f7f-8966d93ceb32`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0

### Texto original
Suddenly, the ground beneath your feet quakes, and a deafening rumble echoes through the air. The peaceful serenity is shattered as a <red><b><incr>Volcanic Fissure</incr></b></red> explodes out of the earth, spewing forth a tide of molten rock and clouds of choking ash.

As you look up, you see a shower of ash and embers falling towards you, a rain of fire and death. It will take only a moment for the molten rock to reach you, for the ash to smother your vision, your breath.

## Fickle Fungus
Chave: `resources.assets:2545593` — GUID: `9c731a7c-bbce-4c95-a4aa-fd9700ec70f0`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0

### Texto original
Even amidst the fantastical nature of your journey, this particular fungus stands as a peculiar sight that draws you closer.

With a cautious curiosity, you move in for a closer look. It is a beautiful, delicate structure, its colors undulating in the ethereal light it emits. As you approach, the fungus seems to react, pulsating in a faster rhythm. Before you can pull back, it releases a sudden cloud of gas, the spores transforming from beautiful light to a dangerous, toxic fog.

Choking and gasping, you stagger back, but not before inhaling a dose of the poisonous spores.

## Foreboding Gem
Chave: `resources.assets:2545595` — GUID: `e4dc06e1-2425-4578-9cd7-087d78eb0d18`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/foreboding gem — SHA objeto: `29d4e6dd01286594affbb4420e4af66f313016e908f282c47fefbcff9a094d75`

### Texto original
This cave, previously draped in a sullen darkness, comes alive in a feverish light. The source of this illumination is a <red><b><incr>Giant Ruby</incr></b></red>, its radiant glow throwing a surreal dance of shadows on the stone walls. This gem is unlike any you had seen before, a pulsating heart in the belly of the earth, casting an allure that is both mesmerizing and disconcerting.

It lays nestled atop a rock pedestal, its facets catching the light and fracturing it into a thousand crimson shards. You find yourself drawn to it, enraptured by its brilliance, your gaze reflected in its fiery depths.

As you venture closer, your steps echo in the cavernous silence, you notice you are not alone. Other shadows move around you, dancing in the ruby's glow, creeping closer. Other adventurers, driven by the same allure, the same pursuit.

A statue, towering and grand, gleams with a lustre untouched by time. The magnificent statue, cast from pure gold, is a testament to the great skill and artistry of the dwarves. It is a glorious depiction of the <gold>First Mountain King</gold>, a legendary figure who laid the foundation for the dwarven kingdom.


You stand in awe, your gaze drawn to the intricately detailed armor, the steadfast expression, and the hefty hammers held firmly in the king's grip. The temptation of the golden figure is potent - it is a treasure that could secure fortunes, a prize that could change your life.

You stand around a <b><gold><incr>Hulking Safe</incr></gold></b>, its matte black exterior reflecting the dim torchlight. The solid steel structure is an intimidating sight, its austere facade is marked only by a complex locking mechanism, a series of concentric rings each adorned with cryptic symbols and numbers.


No visible latch, no obvious keyhole. Just this unyielding enigma waiting to be solved. An opportunity for immense wealth, shrouded in an armor of cold, hardened steel.

## Hell Coffer
Chave: `resources.assets:2545606` — GUID: `f41a780b-f4aa-455c-b26f-895129f63261`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Mythic (4) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/hell coffer — SHA objeto: `f1803712ec88905b8075eee409b77ba21f335d9142ee90dbbf24592222c64aca`

### Texto original
Suspended above a stone pedestal is a <red><b><incr>Hell Coffer</red></b></incr>, an object of legend and fear. Encrusted with jagged obsidian and adorned with runes glowing as though forged in hellfire, the coffer is an infernal masterpiece.

The stories whisper of such artifacts, constructs of the demonic realms where damned lords store their most precious possessions. The promise of the treasure it holds is an intoxicating allure to any mortal. ## Hell Gate
Chave: `resources.assets:2545608` — GUID: `afb86d83-6268-409d-a05d-14709b6713f6`

### Texto original
In a conflagration of heat and ash, a <red><b><incr>Hell Gate</incr></b></red> erupts into existence before you. Its molten edges twist and writhe, the stench of sulfur and brimstone filling the air. It casts a wicked light onto your face, painting the scene in hues of orange and red, flickering like the heart of a fire.


Your heart pounds in your chest, adrenaline surging through your veins as you weigh your options. Flee and live, or stay and face whatever horror is to step from the fiery gateway.

#### Ação 1: Success — RollLimit 0
Bravery, foolhardiness, or a mix of both holds you in place, your eyes never leaving the roiling gate. 

And then, with a final belch of flame and a concussive blast of heat, something does step through. Out from the Hell Gate comes the imposing figure of Lord Infernicus. Towering and monstrous, wreathed in flame, his eyes twin pools of molten lava. Yet, rather than the roar of a challenge, the thunderous voice rings out in confusion.

"Wrong turn,"he mutters as his gaze sweeps over the heroes, his confusion fading into resigned exasperation. "...Ah. Mortals. Why am I not surprised?"

Despite the dire circumstances, the sight of the formidable Lord Infernicus, fresh from a mismanaged gate transit, is almost comical. Almost.

## Hold your Breath
Chave: `resources.assets:2545609` — GUID: `12d253b1-8643-427b-8f35-8b1f402b1c07`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/hold your breath — SHA objeto: `fc04832c3fe0f3f7b99c1346012c7b53c517cd60ac477653fb70764f2fa579e3`

### Texto original
A magical reef, completely out of place on dry land, captures your attention instantly. It is as if a slice of the ocean was suddenly transported and dropped right here in front of you, held in place by an invisible tube of water.

Glowing fish swim around, their luminescent forms painting streaks of color against the murky backdrop. A plethora of coral structures jut out, splashing life onto this land-locked aquatic oasis. Your hand moves forward, pressing against the surface of the cone. The invisible barrier gives way, cool water enveloping your skin as your hand plunges into the underwater wonderland.

Then you spot it – whispers of treasure, glistening from within the underwater biome. The metallic gleam catching the ambient light from the glowing fish and turning it into a beacon calling you.

## Horn of Glorious Battle
Chave: `resources.assets:2545611` — GUID: `26e9ac99-9af8-423f-a024-90459dafd88d`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Rare (2) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/horn of glorious battle — SHA objeto: `bca2d1c1623af110f528e9a4037e8af899669154da8169ca0c2932b7d4194a08`

### Texto original
Resting upon an ancient stone plinth, you discover a horn, grand and ornate, that seems to sing with an unseen power. It is  enormous, constructed of what appeared to be bone or perhaps ivory, sheathed in fine metals and studded with twinkling jewels. Its dwarven craftsmanship is evident in the meticulous detailing, the intricate patterns that wound their way around the horn like a visual symphony.

You've heard tale of such horns of battle. Artifacts that summon allies when sounded... or enemies."

## Inconspicuous Burning Demon Skull
Chave: `resources.assets:2545612` — GUID: `0d898c20-9308-4239-98e6-a1d61fd531bf`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Uncommon (1) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/inconspicuous burning demon skull — SHA objeto: `e07ef2dfae8664cc664f4c089816bd7196954cb67c77c283e7a11d87d4162117`

### Texto original
Before you rests the <color=#EE4B2B><b>burning skull of an infernal fiend</b></color>. It's terrifying bone visage has been blackened by the flames that envelop it. As you approach a harsh voice enters your mind.

<color=#EE4B2B><b>Demon Skull:</b></color> "<i>Hello, mortal!</i>"

<color=#EE4B2B><b>Demon Skull:</b></color> "<i>I am reluctant to admit that I am in need of some aid...</i>"

<color=#EE4B2B><b>Demon Skull:</b></color> "<i>Perhaps we can help each other?! I need <color=#B0E0E6>SOULS</color>! And you need... loot and gold and such.</i>" 

<color=#EE4B2B><b>Demon Skull:</b></color> "<i>Bring me along with you and I will take the souls of those monsters you defeat and in return I will give you <color=#FFD700><b>TREASURE</b></color>!</i>"

## Lady of the Well
Chave: `resources.assets:2545621` — GUID: `32df0034-5a64-4155-92a5-62c6da8c4322`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/lady of the well — SHA objeto: `04c4c09e1998e5fa17491d2ba2d709a5442989e5e23162ec5d36113cdb55e364`

### Texto original
A malaise sweeps over the land as a nebulous shroud emerges from the mouth of an ancient, sealed well. The fog is ethereal, a sickly blend of grays and whites that coil and spin, obscuring the landscape and casting a ghostly pallor over all it touches. It is an aberration, nature corrupted, as if the well was breathing out the stale air of forgotten secrets.


Floating above the well is the spectral figure of a <violet><b><incr>Young Lady</incr></b></violet>, her feet barely grazing the crumbling stone rim. Her garments, once likely the finery of a noblewoman, are stained with centuries of dirt and grime. Her hair, matted and wild, tumbles about her in an untamed veil, obscuring her features but for the haunting glint of her eyes.


Still as an alabaster statue, she emanates an air of tragic beauty. But it is her eyes that held the most terror. For within their depths gleamed an unnatural light, not of this world, reflecting an existence spent trapped between realms. As you shift uneasily beneath her unwavering gaze, it becomes evident - her sightless eyes track you, observing your every move with an intensity that speaks of longing, despair, and a lingering echo of the world she once knew.

#### Ação 1: Success — RollLimit 0
Compelled by curiosity, you cautiously approach the well, your eyes fixed on the ethereal lady. The air around you seems to cool and thicken, the eerie fog swirls and dances around your ankles as if alive. Your heart hammers in your chest, the only sound piercing the suffocating silence of the forgotten landscape.


As you draw near, a horrifying transformation takes place. The spectral figure's passive demeanor abruptly fractures. Her lips pull back into a furious snarl, revealing a grotesque mouth lined with jagged, yellow teeth. Her once serene eyes now burn with a wild, unholy fire, illuminating the well with their malicious glow.


A chilling shriek splits the air, the sound so raw and piercing that it rattles your bones and echoes in your ears. The fog around the well roils and churns, taking on the hue of a stormy sea as the specter's anger manifested.

#### Ação 1: Success — RollLimit 0
Fear, as tangible as the chill in the air, seizes your heart. The young woman's spectral gaze is not merely unsettling; it is a manifestation of a reality too chilling to comprehend.

Turning heel, you flee. Your once sturdy resolve gives way to blind panic, your steps echoing a wild, discordant symphony against the forest floor. 

A hidden root, reaching out from the undergrowth like a gnarled hand, catches your foot mid-stride, upending you. With a gasp of pain and surprise, you crash heavily into the tangle of roots and moss, your ankle sending shoots of searing pain up your leg.

## Lightning Sentry
Chave: `resources.assets:2545624` — GUID: `3c3685cf-05c2-401b-bb42-bd85ae039034`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/lightning sentry — SHA objeto: `2afe8c2022e7653ca3542c505f7a80a557491fd86226b5ab6640f5c23a98bcda`

### Texto original
A tempest of arcing electricity announces the existence of the <blue><b><incr>Lightning Sentry</incr></b></blue>. It stands tall and resolute, like a beacon of raw, crackling power, its metallic structure hums with the melody of contained lightning. A towering column of copper and gold, crowned by a sphere of writhing electric currents that cast flickering shadows across the stone floor. Its azure lightning arcs strike randomly, a dance of deadly energy that promises swift, sizzling retribution to any who dare approach.

## Magic Mirror
Chave: `resources.assets:2545626` — GUID: `bbce0c4c-c4df-4ebd-9b5f-fb745c872dc4`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/magic mirror — SHA objeto: `b963836a68d837b525891818dd9ded9e41c78b6a87346915b9b49103e7962566`

### Texto original
In a room of opulence and decay, you find it: a large mirror of such beauty and craftsmanship it seems out of place amidst the cobweb-laden, moth-eaten grandeur of the cursed castle. Set in an ornate frame, carved with detail, the mirror is mesmerizing, drawing your gaze with an almost magnetic pull.

You squint at the reflection, caught in a moment of curious wonder. But as you look, the reflected image begins to distort.


Your reflection darkens, and a cruel, sinister smile creeps across its face, a chilling contrast to your own stunned expression. It has taken on a life of its own.

The mirror shimmers, and a reflected hand reaches out, stretching beyond the glassy surface and into the reality of the room.

## Mana Spring
Chave: `resources.assets:2545648` — GUID: `13531a98-c63d-4759-a46f-461586e41b3a`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/mana spring — SHA objeto: `0953f64335f46b70871589e37c4e4999be7f048175bdac54daff821fc2370967`

### Texto original
The <blue><b><incr>Mana Spring</incr></b></blue> is an incandescent maelstrom of energy. It bursts from the ground with a radiance that outshines even the brightest stars. Its ethereal tendrils, composed of countless hues of blue, writhe and twist in the air like a celestial dance. This is a rarity, a natural font of pure, unadulterated magical power.


In an area deeply soaked in mystical energy, these springs come into existence. This one is particularly vibrant, a testament to the intense magic that must have suffused the land centuries ago.

## Master of Rage
Chave: `resources.assets:2545651` — GUID: `3c348484-97d8-44fe-9701-7897f376935e`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/master of rage — SHA objeto: `3fb9c0796dbbe1d2ae13fe159df792f2526d4609718b893e01026487da8c39b5`

### Texto original
A hulking mass of muscle and iron stands before you, muscles rippling beneath a tapestry of scars. It is <red><b><incr>Barloc</incr></b></red>, the legendary barbarian. Towering over you, he brandishes two monstrous weapons, each as large as a grown man, with a nonchalance that suggests a life forged in battle and bloodshed.


"Listen well," his voice is a deep rumble, an avalanche given human form. "Rage, it is a fire that burns within us. In the heart of every warrior, in every blow struck, every life taken. It is our greatest weapon, and our greatest enemy."


His eyes smolder like coals boring into your own. "I can show you how to unlock its potential, to harness its power. But you must prove your worth."


He gestures to the north, towards the peak of the summit. "A pack of Wendigo haunts this mountain, twisted creatures consumed by their own sins, fueled by an unholy rage. They were men once. But they have fallen, succumbed to the very fire I speak of."


"Defeat them," he says, his gaze unwavering. "Show me that you can control your rage, not let it control you. Show me that you have the strength, the courage, to face these abominations. Only then, will I impart my teachings to you."

In the face of this mechanical menace, [name] seeks to disarm it, eyes set on a hefty stone off to the side. 

[he] moves swiftly bending down to grip a stone's rough surface. [his] muscles strain with effort, veins bulging on [his] forehead as [he] put every bit of [his] strength into hoisting the rock. But the weight is a reluctant partner in this dangerous dance, stubbornly resistant to [his] desperate endeavor.

The crusher pays no heed to [his] struggles, its rhythm unbroken. [name], trapped in a moment between defiance and desperation, misjudges the tempo. There is a heart-stopping moment when realization flashes across [his] face, a split-second before the crusher came down. [his] scream is cut short by the resounding crash of the metal plate.

## Mistress of Chaos
Chave: `resources.assets:2545653` — GUID: `cdb949de-0865-4063-837c-c395f6c16878`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 0.5

### Texto original
With a reality-bending laugh that echoes within your mind, the Mistress of Chaos unfurls her invitation. Her voice is a melody spun of whispers, a coaxing thread of discord woven into your thoughts. It tastes like temptation, like curiosity, like a gamble against fate.


"Such a dull little toy, you are," she coos, her words a twisted lullaby. "Always playing it safe, always toeing the line. Where's the spark, the flame, the thrill? Let's make things more... entertaining, shall we?"

## Mistress of Chaos
Chave: `resources.assets:2545655` — GUID: `c96278b1-90ed-46c8-8e50-9dc6d6d2cdf0`

### Texto original
With a reality-bending laugh that echoes within your mind, the Mistress of Chaos unfurls her invitation. Her voice is a melody spun of whispers, a coaxing thread of discord woven into your thoughts. It tastes like temptation, like curiosity, like a gamble against fate.


"Such a dull little toy, you are," she coos, her words a twisted lullaby. "Always playing it safe, always toeing the line. Where's the spark, the flame, the thrill? Let's make things more... entertaining, shall we?"

## Party like a Pirate
Chave: `resources.assets:2545664` — GUID: `385d6042-6c20-4ee0-9791-a7a4ec12ae03`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0

### Texto original
 It is a carnival of morbid mirth, with skeletal figures frozen in place, their joyous revelry cut short by death. It is an uncanny scene, death masquerading as life, and you feel an unspoken kinship with these jovial souls.


A mug, clenched in the bony hand of a particularly well-dressed skeleton, calls to you. The sloshing liquid inside glowing amber under the light, and a tempting aroma wafts towards you. You can almost hear the teasing invitations of the dead mariners. "Have a sip, lad," a raspy, otherworldly voice seems to whisper, "Join us in our eternal merriment."

## Petrified Party
Chave: `resources.assets:2545665` — GUID: `6305378b-1b85-480c-99b2-1a94f88ea10d`

### Texto original
An adventuring party stands frozen mid-motion, their expressions etched with surprise, terror, and desperate determination. As if some cruel force has trapped them in an eternal, still tableau of their last moments.

There is a haunting quality about the sight, an unnatural stillness that speaks of a deadly magic. The kind of magic that could turn flesh and bone into solid stone. You shiver, a feeling of dread prickling at your senses. This is the fate of those who venture too far, who dare to challenge the unknown.

Bathed in the golden hues of a sinking sun, a skeletal figure, garbed in tattered remnants of what once was a flamboyant pirate's attire, clings tightly to a worn wooden chest. In life and death, the pirate had a singular devotion to his hoard, a silent testament to the destructive allure of greed.

A sense of unease trickles down your spine. It is a scene straight out of a mariner’s cautionary tale, a grim reminder that even in death, the pirate’s lust for treasure has not waned. But you are no fool. You know the risks, the tales of cursed gold and vengeful spirits, yet the allure of the treasure is strong.

## Rockslide!
Chave: `resources.assets:2545673` — GUID: `5cefc375-183e-4d07-a3e8-5e01470d1fc5`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/rockslide! — SHA objeto: `cd063482774fd55019e7a24bff69fa66c03898845e23b6a1acea871dd213b052`

### Texto original
As you press onward, the rugged path begins to tremble beneath your boots. Small pebbles tumble past you, clattering noisily on the ground. A deafening rumble fills the air, drowning out the whistling of the wind and the calls of distant birds. You freeze, understanding dawning on you like a bolt of cold lightning. You are caught in a <red><b><incr>Rockslide</incr></b></red>.


Your instincts scream at you to move, to run, but your mind is racing, trying to calculate a path of escape. Rocks, large and small, break free from the mountain face above you, careening down with a speed and force that holds in it the promise of death.

### Resultados possíveis (texto autoral)
You have only a moment to react!

You zigzag your way forward, narrowly avoiding boulders that crash down around you, the shockwaves from their impact threatening to topple you over. Each moment seems to stretch, your life hanging in a precarious balance that could tip over at any moment.


And then, with a final burst of energy, you launch yourself into the air, tucking your body as you roll into the cover of an overhang. You cover your head as rocks batter the ground mere feet from where you lay, your breath coming in short, shaky bursts.

## Runed Obelisk
Chave: `resources.assets:2545674` — GUID: `42f00a9a-3f49-4431-9a88-bf4301b14872`

### Texto original
Before you rises an obelisk of hewn sandstone, solitary and ancient. The monolith's surface is etched with the brutal reality of time, but a rune of sapphire nestled at its heart pulses with a serene light, untouched by the centuries.

Drawn by the intoxicating power the rune emanates, you step closer, squinting against light. Each step throws your shadow against the towering stone, dwarfing you yet infusing you with a sense of determination.

### Texto original
A wall of sand rises in the distance, a monstrous tidal wave dwarfing everything in its path. The <red><b><incr>Sandstorm</incr></b></red> charges forward, obliterating the line between sky and earth, reducing your world to a violent haze of golden fury.

Your lips are soon parched, and every breath you take is laden with dust, but surrendering is not an option. The world around you disappears into a blur of swirling sand, each gust of wind stinging like a thousand tiny knives against your exposed skin.

Hefting your cloak around your shoulders, you press on.Your heartbeat thunders in your ears, providing a rhythm that guides your steps. Your breathing, harsh and ragged, becomes a melody that harmonizes with the howling winds. 

Hours blur into moments, and time seems to lose its meaning. But, at long last, the fury of the storm begins to diminish. The whirling wall of sand recedes, revealing a sky filled with stars that blink down at you like age-old spectators, witnessing the end of this ordeal.

#### Ação 2: Failure — RollLimit 1
Wind howls around you like a horde of vengeful spirits, tearing at your cloak and stealing your breath away. Your eyes, shielded behind your hands, sting as the fine particles slip past your defenses. 

Your legs, once firm and sure on the sand, begin to waver under the sheer force of the wind. You stumble once, then twice. Your footing slips beneath you, sending you sprawling onto the shifting dunes. You try to rise, to continue to push against the sandstorm's assault, but the desert is too strong, too persistent.

## Scent of Blood
Chave: `resources.assets:2545678` — GUID: `60994b86-838b-4672-84f0-c99f87942e82`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/scent of blood - battle — SHA objeto: `255d467f9cf16885727023009df9dd3e73b4989a9b7090765577cf4a8e019292`

### Texto original
A chilling howl pierces the silence of the mountain, sending shivers down your spine. From the blinding sleet emerges a massive, albino werewolf. Its ghostly white fur would blend seemlessly into the surrounding tundra if not for the blood splattered on its coat and haunting red eyes that glow like embers in the snow. 

"Why do you trespass on my mountain?" <red><b><incr>The Werewolf</incr></b></red> snarls at you, its voice a chilling mix of human and beast.

"Run along, little lamb, or I will feed on your meager strength, and leave your tortured spirit to haunt this land forever."

## Shawn the Benevolent
Chave: `resources.assets:2545680` — GUID: `bc6f155e-352d-41e3-9863-b4c6548c13e9`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/shawn the benevolent — SHA objeto: `3217ca49c8fe365e0e4e63b8a8745fedc38ba38c303956f0a47818b4a8348f0f`

### Texto original
The scent of charred bone and the sickly glow of burning skulls greets you. A <red><b><incr>Red Demon</incr></b></red> stands massive and menacing, his scarlet skin glints like polished stone. His eyes, glowing like hot coals, observe you with a look of dark amusement. The demon's trophies, the skulls of unfortunate souls impaled on spikes, surround him, burning over a smouldering fire.

You feel the air thicken with a menacing aura as the demon regards you, a crooked grin stretching across his monstrous face. "<red>Another mortal seeking riches,</red>" the demon booms, its voice echoing off the stone walls. "<red>I can see it in your eyes. You want to plunder the depths of this realm for treasure.</red>"

"<red>I offer you a deal, mortal,</red>" the demon continues, leaning towards you. His voice drops to a low purr, slick with deceit. "<red>Your strength for my blessing. Treasure beyond your wildest dreams will you find, but you must bear my mark, a sign of our agreement.</red>”

### Opção 1: Accept

#### Ação 1: Success — RollLimit 0
A laugh, dark and triumphant, eruptes from the demon. "<red>Ahhh, the greed of mortals never fails to amuse me,</red>" he sneers, his burning eyes gleaming with vicious delight. He raises one clawed hand, a corona of crimson energy gathers at his fingertips.

"<red>You shall have your blessing. As well as the curse that comes with it.</red>" With a swift, downward stroke, the demon slashes the energy across you. A searing heat courses through your veins, a potent cocktail of pain and power. Your knees buckle under the intensity, but you stay upright, clenching your fists.

The demon steps back, admiring his handiwork with a twisted smile. "<red>Let your greed guide you, mortal. For now, you are bound to the curse and the blessing. May you find the treasure you seek...and may the cost not be too high.</red>"

With a final, malicious chuckle, the demon vanishes, leaving you alone, the echo of his laughter lingers like a haunting promise.

The demon's laughter echoes around you, a chilling, mirthless sound. "Very well," he says, his burning eyes flashing with malicious delight. "Run along, mortal. But remember this. It is in your nature to be greedy. To want more than what you have. You will be back."

## Shrine of the Conqueror
Chave: `resources.assets:2545681` — GUID: `cfb83f35-3814-4303-ad5f-808f055ee5ab`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Rare (2) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/shrine of the conqueror — SHA objeto: `05cf7da4eb18b4efa9269fd1ed34cad00bc89b2b579e21c1d92c642b6590422a`

### Texto original
You stand in awe of the towering statue of <gold><b><incr>The Conqueror</incr></b></gold>, cast in finely hewn stone and bathed in celestial light. He is known well in the Stolen Realm, a legend whispered about in awe and veneration. His pose is one of undeniable valor, his mighty weapon held aloft, as if beckoning the armies of the world to follow in its wake. A figure of myth and history, a man who made all the Stolen Realm kneel to his glory.

## Shrine of the Guardian
Chave: `resources.assets:2545682` — GUID: `960d6c56-40e8-40eb-8d70-bedda514a72f`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Uncommon (1) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/shrine of the guardian — SHA objeto: `ce2aef7107853f009274fc055a122bb0413e0667269bb7964043ed34daf8143c`

### Texto original
You pause at the foot of a stone statue, craning your neck to gaze at the imposing figure of <gold><b><incr>The Guardian</incr></b></gold>. Chiseled from rough gray stone, The Guardian stands resolute and unyielding. Dressed in the etched lines of intricate armor, one hand is clasped around the pommel of a sword, its point embedded in the stone beneath. His other arm bares a shield, a rock against the tide. A silent, stoic sentinel, the statue embodies the spirit of the last defender of the Stolen Realm.


The ground around the base of the statue is littered with shields of all shapes, sizes, and conditions. Some are old and weather-worn, edges chipped and colors faded. Others are freshly made, their polished surfaces reflecting the sky above. Each one is a testament of respect and admiration, an offering laid by those who admire and honor The Guardian.

## Shrine of the Rogue
Chave: `resources.assets:2545683` — GUID: `e6092432-340e-45a2-b9fb-436b3de72e25`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Uncommon (1) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/shrine of the rogue — SHA objeto: `944a9332e976d728d979039581743936dac5da6c988fa0dd071068dbd699bd32`

### Texto original
Ahead of you, cloaked in veils of shadow and dappled light, stands a stone statue - one that bares a solemn, familiar reverence.


Its form is hunched yet poised, shrouded in the etched folds of a cloak. An angular hood hangs low, casting an eternal shadow over where a face would be. <gold><b><incr>The Rogue</incr></b></gold>. A man of shadows and stealth, he used his cunning and bravery to fight a war that seemed unwinnable. He had taken on a legion of oppressors, armed with naught but a sharp blade and sharper wit.


In life, he was an elusive phantom of justice, a beacon of hope for the oppressed.  In death, he remains a symbol of resilience for the disenfranchised, the downtrodden, and the brave hearts who dare to resist tyranny.

## Shrine of the Warrior
Chave: `resources.assets:2545684` — GUID: `7cfa58fe-1a9e-4f3f-92d1-1cb26535f8c1`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Uncommon (1) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/shrine of the warrior — SHA objeto: `a921c463a47a0fafd2ba9cfd813506ccde724cade7f5a0deffccc29a3e03c131`

### Texto original
In the heart of an ancient battlefield, a monument of heroism stands unbroken. A stoic figure of a warrior in stone, his head bowed as if eternally in prayer. The statue, chiseled to perfection, resembles <gold><b><incr> The Warrior</incr></b></gold> - a crusader whose tales of valor echo throughout the Stolen Realm. Clad in a robe of hard granite, the figure is frozen in a posture of deep respect, its helmeted face hidden from the world.

The broadsword in his grasp points downwards, its tip nestled in the ground, symbolizing his humility despite his power. His armor, detailed with lifelike intricacies in the stone, stands as a testament to his courage and strength. The very air around the statue seems heavy with the weight of countless battles fought, victories won, and sacrifices made.

At the foot of the statue, a brazier burns with an ethereal light, flickering shadows playing on the stone warrior’s form. The metal of various weapons – swords, axes, daggers, laid out meticulously across the brazier - glow in the spectral flame. These are offerings, tokens of respect and admiration left by fellow warriors, or maybe those who aspire to be, drawn here by the legacy of the Warrior.

## Shrine to the Reaper
Chave: `resources.assets:2545685` — GUID: `9fd9a987-929a-4d04-b471-ff09f0c84608`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Rare (2) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/shrine to the reaper — SHA objeto: `aeb32468226d394ea2f71a5353b6740685ac154a47e9b8c2d7cb34cd09f91429`

### Texto original
The stone form of <red><b><incr>The Reaper</incr></b></red> stands tall and ominous, a stark reminder of the cycle of life and death. Clad in a robe that drapes over its skeletal form, its bony hand clutches a scythe – the ubiquitous symbol of its office.

It is as though the Reaper himself watches, his hooded skull turned slightly, giving the uncanny impression of an eternal gaze. The cold, unfeeling visage seems to regard you with an indifference that is profoundly unsettling.

At the feet of the Reaper, a stone basin is filled with dark, congealing blood, an offering from those desperate to stave off their own mortality. Surrounding the basin, candles flicker like distant stars against the pitch-black cloak of the Reaper, casting dancing shadows upon the stone. The air hangs heavy with the scent of wax and iron.

## Shrine to the Seraph
Chave: `resources.assets:2545686` — GUID: `30dcb1d9-157a-485a-9587-dcb3363c6c68`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Uncommon (1) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/shrine to the seraph — SHA objeto: `4de5f8b32cb606a41ca9c349665d3ee55949102dee41ae4fffc173e351120ca8`

### Texto original
You stand still, beholding a monument of mercy. A statue of <gold><b><incr>The Seraph</incr></b></gold>, carved from white marble, gleams in the soft glow of the fading light. Her outspread wings arch gracefully, rising majestically against the sky. Her arms are open wide, an invitation for peace and healing to all who venture near. Her face, weathered by time, still bore the vestiges of an angelic smile, and her eyes—though made of cold stone—radiated a warmth and compassion that is almost tangible.

Beneath the Seraph, the clear pool of water shimmers, reflecting her image with such purity that it is as though a second angel resides within the depths. Nestled amidst the fine pebbles at the bottom of the pool, countless gold coins wink back at you, catching the light in glimmering facets. These are the offerings of the weary, the grateful, the hopeful. Tokens of their faith and their gratitude for the Seraph's guidance, tossed into the water in hopes of gaining her favor, or simply to honor her benevolence.

## Shrine to the Shaman
Chave: `resources.assets:2545687` — GUID: `36973ac6-9f37-4c4a-b195-3ac33d0611d5`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/shrine to the shaman — SHA objeto: `bba96436eb2b33407b5e102a478c1489480d56d81c2bcdcf82df3f5bfa3c1367`

### Texto original
The stone figure of <gold><b><incr>The Shaman</incr></b></gold> stands stark against the swirling snowfall, ancient as the earth itself and enduring as the bone-chilling winds that sweep across the vast wilderness. Jagged etchings crease its stern visage, time and weather having wrought their own stories upon the stone. A helmet, adorned with cracked horns sits atop a weathered, bearded face. Light flickers from the torches on either side, casting an eerie light upon the monolith, emphasizing the parts that are unfinished; the details fading out, blending into the rock as if the artist had simply allowed the elements to claim what was theirs.


His reign is marked by a profound respect for the spirits of the land and sky. In life, he was a fountain of strength and spiritual guidance, uniting the northern tribes in harmony with the harsh, beautiful land they called home. In death, he is said to continue protecting his people, his spirit joining the ancestral guardians in their eternal watch over the tribes.

## Snowstorm!

### Texto original
A savage <blue><b><incr>Snowstorm</incr></b></blue> rips through the frozen wilds, swallowing the familiar landmarks and the sparse shelter of the evergreens in a swirling abyss of white. Even the sun is smothered by the relentless snowfall, plunging the world into an eerie, muted twilight. The temperature plummets, each breath seizing your lungs with an icy grip.

## Spear Trap
Chave: `resources.assets:2545691` — GUID: `13817dd0-dd84-421e-bdb0-88e3f633c929`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/spear trap — SHA objeto: `d23eebf5d182f5de16699264fb15ba0b28ab8a60af84f27466523da0b5cc24ae`

### Texto original
Crisscrossed patterns of holes punctuatethe otherwise unremarkable floor. Periodically, spears thrust out from the holes in a sudden, violent eruption of deadly force before retracting back into the stone floor. The <red><b><incr>Spear Trap</incr></b></red> has an organic rhythm to it, like a beast's heartbeat, savage and relentless.

The spears are crudely fashioned, their tips are sharpened stone, secured to thick wooden shafts with rough, leather bindings. But their primitive appearance belies their lethal potential. The trap is set to skewer anyone or anything that stepped into its path without proper caution.

## Strange Crystal
Chave: `resources.assets:2545696` — GUID: `b788d19c-f4c6-4884-a73b-70316efe8684`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0

### Texto original
In the parched dunes of Wyrmrest Desert, you find a gleaming anomaly that seems to defy the reality of its surroundings. A <blue><b><incr>Strange Crystal</incr></b></blue> floats eerily above the hot sand, its very presence carving out a radius of chilling winter within the searing landscape. Snow falls gently around it, each flake sparkling like diamond dust in the stark contrast of the desert sun. An oasis of cold in the sweltering desert.

With every step closer, the oppressive desert heat is replaced by an increasingly frigid blast. You steel yourself against the cold, squinting up at the magnificent crystal. There is something about the frosty gem that seems to promise immense power.

Hovering in front of you is a <yellow><b><incr>Strange Crystal</incr></b></yellow> of immense size, glimmering and reflecting the stormy skies overhead. 

Your heart pounds as you approach the mesmerizing crystal, drawn by its captivating allure.

## Sword in the Stone
Chave: `resources.assets:2545707` — GUID: `696ca858-700e-422f-8c63-edb61dda4e1c`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/sword in the stone — SHA objeto: `03c65db52323405fe93c1009d0d59d9f5a9abbcbdddef0e54bbc78e83a088e16`

### Texto original
Deep within the forest you find a gleaming <b><gold>Sword</gold></b> lodged into a massive stone, the brilliant sheen of its blade contrasts starkly against the dull gray of the rock. The weapon is an artwork, its craftsmanship surpassing anything you have seen before. It is an enigma, a beacon of lustrous steel amidst the undergrowth and detritus.

You approached the sword, captivated by its beauty. Its hilt is wrought of intricately interwoven patterns, a delicate dance of metal that hints at the work of a master smith. The blade itself is magnificent, a length of flawless steel that shines as if it were the day it were forged. How long it has been here is unknowable, but its splendor has clearly withstood the test of time.

## Talk to the Spirits.
Chave: `resources.assets:2545710` — GUID: `94acc548-5d82-4605-a78b-f09748a50c0b`

### Texto original
A gnarled goblin, thin and aged, sits hunched over a crackling blue fire. He hums softly, a low, melodic chant that seems to echo within the flames.


The goblin lifts his gaze to meet yours. His eyes hold the weight of centuries, but there is a spark of wisdom there, a knowing that surpasses the mere comprehension of time. "Your ancestors," he rasps, his voice like the crackling of dry leaves. "They wish to speak with you. Will you pay the price, to hear them?"

## Talking Suit of Armor
Chave: `resources.assets:2545711` — GUID: `767772c7-68a5-48b1-9fc6-e1f502fa4cfb`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Uncommon (1) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/talking suit of armor — SHA objeto: `081b13c288b4e97a74b659d5c206e0af8adc985f71ccdd8d36203c1d295b57ab`

### Texto original
Your eyes are drawn to a decorative armor stand proudly displayed on a stone pedestal. A suit of armor stands resolute, the burnished steel gleaming in the light.


You approach the armor stand, eyes wide with admiration as you take in the ornate detailing. The intricate scrollwork and gem-encrusted embellishments speak of a time when glory and honor were as much a part of a warrior's armor as the steel that protected him.


Just as you reach out a hand to trace the decorative etchings, a deep voice echoes from within the armor, causing you to jump back in surprise.


"Hold there, knave!" The voice boomed out, gruff and resonating within the metallic shell. "With armor as stained as yours, I'm surprised you dare to touch mine!"

"And those weapons, dull as a rusted spoon!" The voice continued with more than a hint of disgust. "They'd barely nick a foe, let alone strike a fatal blow. You wouldn't have lasted a minute in the decorated company of <silver><b><incr>Captain Henry Irons</incr></b></silver>!"

## Target Dummy Practice: Expert
Chave: `resources.assets:2545712` — GUID: `7a266af9-0c86-4165-a05f-4eb9b70fbf1b`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Legendary (3) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/target dummy practice_ expert — SHA objeto: `0a45d17474cf820e433e69868111cdc428abd702848dd56067f9e162195bf2ed`

### Texto original
Arrayed before you stand four <silver><b><incr>Armored Target Dummies</incr></b></silver>, motionless metal sentinels. Yet, as you approach, a voice calls out, strangely alive and full of mirth. “Well, well,” it cackles, the sound strangely amplified around you. “What have we here? The sorriest excuse for a hero I've ever seen."

Your brow furrows in confusion, but before you can react, another voice chimes in. "You call those muscles? My grandma's knitting needles are thicker!"

The jibes seem to come from the dummies, a bizarre enchantment has breathed life into them. 

"Go on, hero," a dummy taunts, "Show us what little you've got."

## Target Dummy Practice: Novice
Chave: `resources.assets:2545713` — GUID: `a3161d22-3f5d-4ef4-8604-e8c0278722a0`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Uncommon (1) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/target dummy practice_ novice — SHA objeto: `56dd249f4b119e39853c8e70a847f284d6187eab599a7292912021b371a9c6af`

### Texto original
Four simple <green><b><incr>Target Dummies</incr></b></green> stand assembled in front of you. Identical and humble in their simplicity. Yet, as you step closer, a voice calls out.


"Aha! Boys, look here!" comes a rough, husky voice that is decidedly out of place coming from an inanimate object. You glance around, a puzzled look on your face, your eyes finally landing on the straw dummies.


"Look at this sorry sight," the voice continues, a chuckle in its tone. "I think we're looking at the walking definition of a 'zero.' Is there such a thing as the opposite of a hero? Because if so, that's what you are."


A chorus of laughter rings out from the straw figures.

## The Animator
Chave: `resources.assets:2545732` — GUID: `7d008743-08fc-4746-b4c9-2201f70b530f`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/the animator — SHA objeto: `6ed7c8d05e78c6a1bd7d62bbdad9a78cda3b1ae40b06fc92115994f4c18c7f45`

### Texto original
The glow of a dim lantern casts eerie shadows on the cavern walls, illuminating the determined figure of a woman as she diligently works on a massive iron golem. Tools and scraps of metal litter the ground around her, and the low echo of her humming resonates throughout the cave.

Looking up in surprise, her eyes quickly flicker with a spark of intrigue as she takes you in. "Well, look who the night dragged in," she says with a chuckle, brushing back a loose strand of hair from her face.


"I'm known as '<gold><incr><b>The Animator</b></incr></gold>', but you can call me Annie," she says, her voice carrying a lively lilt as she gestures to the metal monolith beside her. The golem is an impressive sight - a titan of iron and magic, currently lifeless and cold.


"My iron giant here seems to have run out of juice," she admits with a sheepish smile. "You see, he's powered by the hearts of <b><red><incr>Fire Demons</incr></red></b>. Mighty tough to acquire, but oh-so efficient."


A light dances in her eyes as she looks you over, sizing you up. "I've got a proposal for you," she says, her voice taking on a hopeful tone. "There's a pack of those beasts nearby, stirring up all kinds of trouble. If you can handle them, bring me their hearts. In return, I'll lend you my golem's assistance once he's back up and running. What do you say?"

## The Fortune Teller
Chave: `resources.assets:2545734` — GUID: `2ca74161-3fe7-459d-bdd7-1b6f4741edc4`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/the fortune teller — SHA objeto: `a7921a9fecf2fbb651938a45804da533e3c32b254805261b887c795ba07643b2`

### Texto original
Your eyes are drawn to a mysterious figure standing in a clearing, the glow from a crystal ball illuminates her elegant features. Her hair is the color of moonlight, her eyes as deep as the forest night, and her ears bare the unmistakable point of the elven race.

Without lifting her gaze from the swirling mists within the crystal ball, she greets you. "Welcome, adventurer. I have been expecting you." Her fingers trace patterns over the surface of the crystal ball. "Fate has woven a curious tapestry for you. As a seer, it is my task to reveal its design."

As she speaks, the mists within the crystal ball swirl and coalesce, forming vivid images.

## The Fortune Teller (Test)
Chave: `resources.assets:2545733` — GUID: `e987802d-9895-46d4-a815-69b95b52633e`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/the fortune teller (test) — SHA objeto: `2d30eb696c1627542fbe9a069b993f298283a1f2c48a5eebb24ef08ff95a395a`

### Texto original
A <violet><b><incr>Mysterious Elf</incr></b></violet> stands before a glimmering Crystal Ball. She stares intently into the Crystal and greets you without looking up.

"Welcome Heroes, I have been expecting you."

"I, the wonderous <violet><b><incr>Fortune Teller</incr></b></violet>, shall grant you a gift. Look into the Crystal Ball and you will see your future!"

The bookshelf stands tall and imposing, a silent guardian of untold knowledge and secrets. Each shelf is laden with worn-out tomes, their leather-bound covers etched with golden glyphs, their pages yellowed with age. It is a treasure trove of forgotten lore and secret wisdom, just waiting to be discovered.

With a low grinding sound that echoes through the quiet chamber, the entire bookshelf begins to swing forward, revealing a hidden alcove behind. Your heart pounds in anticipation. Inside the alcove, atop a marble pedestal, rested a book far grander than any you have ever seen.


The Tome of Tadashi.

## The Mad Mage
Chave: `resources.assets:2545739` — GUID: `435d6bd4-fa60-4982-85f8-e4a0ec083837`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/the mad mage 1 — SHA objeto: `b90a6fbfefd304dfcbe5d41656f71b8fc4bc807204fdae7d1cbf5a0323dd01f0`

### Texto original
A lone prisoner, clothed in frayed rags, stands in a circle of magic chains. Each glows with a strange power. One blazes with searing fire, the second shimmers with frosty ice, and the third crackles with wild bolts of thunder and lightning.

As you approach, the prisoner's eyes flicker to life, a spark of hope kindling within the depth of his tired gaze. You...you can free me," he raspes, his voice hoarse from disuse. "I beg you, grant me this freedom. Look at me, bound by the cruelty of these chains. They leech my power, my essence." 

His eyes, a mirror to his tormented soul, flash with a haunting light as he glances down at the chains. "Help me, and I will help you. It is a trade, a pact, an oath. I've been trapped here for centuries, my power bound, my voice unheard. Release me from this torment, adventurer." he pleads.

## The Most Dangerous Game
Chave: `resources.assets:2545742` — GUID: `764378be-fa1c-43ef-b0e1-6669614105d4`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/the most dangerous game — SHA objeto: `1cdd052e476e72552b76b51da3691679448c7c793d529da0ca0be838901c7206`

### Texto original
A robust figure stands by a fireplace, the orange light dancing in her eyes. With a musket resting in her hands and a bear skin rug beneath her boots, she exudes a commanding presence. The sight of the horrifying trophy hanging above the fireplace sends a shiver down your spine - the severed head of the dreaded Pig Butcher. <gold><incr><b>Sully Walker, the master hunter</b></incr></gold>, greets you.

"Quite a sight, isn't it?" she booms, her eyes not leaving you as she gestures to the monstrous head. "Nothing puts the fear of the wilderness into a man quite like the face of his nightmares, eh?"

You clear your throat, nodding in agreement. The grotesque visage of the Pig Butcher is indeed a horrifying sight to behold.

"And what about you, wanderer?" Sully asks, her voice dropping to a conspiratorial whisper. "What's the most dangerous game you've ever hunted down?"

#### Ação 1: Success — RollLimit 15
"I once tracked a Green Dragon," you begin, your voice steady, "A beast so fierce it could summon lightning from a clear sky, and so swift it could outrun the wind itself."


You spin a tale with precision, describing the creature's terrifying speed and its deadly electric attacks. You detail your strategy, the patience required to exploit the brief window of opportunity when the beast is momentarily weakened after an attack. The dramatic climax of your story is the final blow, a desperate strike at the dragon's heart, a leap of faith that could have easily been your last.

"By the gods," Sully mutteres, her eyes bright with respect, "You've got the heart of a lion, adventurer. I'll wager that dragon didn't know what hit it."

## The Old Well
Chave: `resources.assets:2545743` — GUID: `930f331a-b7fc-49d6-9e7a-1022733e2fca`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/the old well — SHA objeto: `eb8a01f1f7f3a2a524685b0431fe49b7bb911bb99abf5b7a569c9078889ec6da`

### Texto original
You stumble upon an aged well, long abandoned by any surrounding civilization. Its stones, covered in dirt and weathered by time, whisper tales of bygone days.

Curiosity draws you to the edge of the well, where you find a rusted crank and frayed rope. Tentatively, you lean over, peering into the abyss. The well is deep, and the blackness within is a consuming void, its depth unknown and unnerving. Yet, something glitters within the shadows, a tantalizing spark amidst the inky blackness.

## The runes of the Ymir
Chave: `resources.assets:2545785` — GUID: `8e63fbe4-3e26-49fc-b9f0-8f4aa4676f67`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/ymir rune, strength — SHA objeto: `6969627c3b9ad49fbac44c24c3e2f3dc2f31abfd2456810f81a06226c3cd0557`

### Texto original
A monolith of ancient ice towers over you, its frosted surface etched with runes of an age long past, the forgotten language of the Ymir. Every stroke of the rune is a story, each etching an echo of a bygone era. And as your gaze traces over them, you feel an odd attraction, a pull that leads you closer, until the ancient ice is mere inches from your face. Its surface, frigid and firm, seems to smoke in the cold, sending up curls of fog that spiral towards the stark white sky.

### Resultados possíveis (texto autoral)

#### Ação 1: Success — RollLimit 0
You reach out, your hand trembling slightly, and placed your palm onto the ice.


Immediately, a chill sweeps through you, not the biting sting of frostbite, but rather a soothing coolness that reaches your very core. It flows through your veins like a river of tranquility, quieting the whispers of worry that dance at the edges of your consciousness. But this fleeting moment of tranquility shatters abruptly, fragmented by a thunderous roar that echoes off the frozen surroundings.

It is a polar bear, its fur as white as the surrounding snowscape. Glowing blue runes dance over the bear's fur like the heart of an icy flame. Its roar rings out again, the sound rumbling through the ice and the snow, and meeting the echo of the ancient rune in a symphony of old magic.

## Tornado!
Chave: `resources.assets:2545751` — GUID: `cebeebab-3728-45fa-aab6-cdab1f351041`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/tornado! — SHA objeto: `28c735107e22c354b1e0e69e1844714fc536f873a8e46b6c731215074ce965d5`

### Texto original
A <blue><b><incr>Tornado</incr></b></blue>, a monstrous titan of air and fury, touches down with a ferocity that makes the very earth beneath you shudder. It is a terrifying spectacle, an embodiment of nature's raw, uncontrollable power.


The world becomes a maelic whirlwind of chaos. The tornado's winds howl like banshees, pulling at you with the inexorable force of a monstrous vortex. Debris spins in a deadly dance around the twister's base, and you know you have but moments to react.

## Transcendence
Chave: `resources.assets:2545752` — GUID: `1a9b1d33-3893-4c82-8093-6f4f234d13a5`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/transcendence — SHA objeto: `f37c2938d0e2dd1d23da2c9fcb2c075acd52fa399b19912162b46d9b26d8f630`

### Texto original
Underneath a majestic cherry blossom tree, an old man stands, wreathed in a shower of falling blossoms. His eyes are closed, his face calm and peaceful, reflecting an inner tranquility that seems to permeate the very air around him.


The man is old, his skin lined like a well-weathered parchment, and a silver mustache flows down to his chest. His attire is simple, but it had a quality of elegance and humility. It is clear that he is a man who has distilled the essence of his life to the simple act of existence.

As you approach, the old man opens his eyes, those clear orbs holding depths of wisdom and understanding. His gaze scans you, taking in the battle-worn armor, the well-used weapons, the aura of determination and purpose. It is a look that seems to bypass the physical, reaching to the core of your being.

"You carry the weight of the world on your shoulders, young one," the old man says softly, his voice a gentle murmur amid the rustling cherry blossoms. "You strive and struggle, battling forces beyond your control. But I say to you: even the mightiest tree needs time to rest and grow."


He gestures to the cherry blossom tree above you. "Look at these blossoms. They do not strive, do not battle. They simply are. They exist, beautiful in their transience. They do not fear their fall, for they know it is but a part of their journey."


He turns his gaze back to you, a soft smile playing on his lips. "Rest here, warrior. Set aside your worldly concerns. In the silence of the heart, free from the clamor of material pursuits, you will find your true purpose."

With cautious excitement, you approach, reaching out to lift its heavy lid.  Your fingers brush over the cool bronze lock. But the moment your hand makes contact, the world blurs into a nightmare.

The wood groans and twists, while the bronze bands open revealing a grotesque, gaping maw. It is not a chest, but a Mimic, a deadly creature adept at luring in unwary adventurers.

## Treasure Hunter
Chave: `resources.assets:2545759` — GUID: `252cb65e-0e91-4d55-bf03-2a05cffa9d3c`

### Texto original
Your path crosses with another adventurer, a treasure hunter of sorts. He is an older man, his eyes gleaming with an avid curiosity that belies his age, hunched over what seems to be a collection of parchment and maps spread out on a makeshift wooden table.

"Hero!" he greets, his voice coarse but spirited. "You appear just in time. I am on the verge of a great discovery. The Treasure of Moltendunn, the spoils of a legendary kingdom, lost for countless generations. This map," he points at the worn parchment, "may just hold the key."

In the parched, wind-swept land of Wyrmrest Desert, a great monstrosity mars the horizon. The grotesque corpse of a colossal ogre, every inch of its leathery hide etched with deep, bloody gashes. Even from a distance, the stench of death washes over you, a fetid miasma that permeates the air, replacing the usual dry desert scent with a noxious, gut-churning odor.

#### Ação 1: Success — RollLimit 0
Suddenly, a movement catches your eye. The ogre's enormous form jerks, then begins sinking into the sand. A giant, armored claw reaches up from the earth, pulling the lifeless bulk down with alarming strength.

Dread settles in the pit of your stomach as the sands around you begin to churn. A low rumble, a vibration beneath your boots - you were not alone. An armored behemoth erupts from the sand, its body encased in a menacing carapace of spikes. Towering over you, the beast stands hunched, its long spiked tail thrashing restlessly. Its head is a horrifying display of jagged spikes and gnashing mandibles.

## Witch's Cauldron
Chave: `resources.assets:2545774` — GUID: `25e5d830-d905-49f6-8141-49be866c6056`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/witch's cauldron — SHA objeto: `efd0904dd0fe157bca8eb22ddc43847e9641839538acab0d4c3dc6bc183e84d1`

### Texto original
In the heart of the Sunken Swamp, you find a small clearing where an <green><b><incr>Ancient Hag</incr></b></green> squats, her skeletal figure hunched over a bubbling cauldron. The container hisses and sputters, spewing a sickly green concoction that spatters onto the surrounding soil, instantly shriveling any plant life it touches.


The putrid odor is nearly unbearable. It permeates the air, a malodorous blend of swamp water, rot, and something undefinably sour. As the smell reaches you, a wave of revulsion washes over you, your stomach lurches in protest. You can taste the bile rising in your throat.


You try to turn away but you cannot. Your hand, seemingly of its own volition, stretches out towards the cauldron. You try to pull back, to wrench your hand away from the vile brew, but it moves as if bewitched, resisting your will. Your fingers skim the surface of the seething liquid, scooping up a handful. You watch in wide-eyed horror as your possessed hands bring the potion to your lips.


The hag cackles in delight, her voice a rasping echo that bounces off the gnarled tree trunks. Her eyes, two pinpricks of cruel light in her wrinkled visage, gleam with mirth and malice.

## Witch's Pyre
Chave: `resources.assets:2545776` — GUID: `25028950-77c6-46ed-ba01-36f25d817793`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/witch's pyre — SHA objeto: `f796144bdf12ac0608c38938cd02eba16dc936d96074b03aec88641d8cdc37e6`

### Texto original
A smoldering pyre blazes amidst the damp moss and hanging vines of the swamp, its feral light casting long, twisted shadows across the gloom. The sight is as fascinating as it is harrowing. 

The fire dances and writhes, a serpent set ablaze, consuming all that is offered to it. All, save for the spectral figure at its heart. The witch, it seems, is not affected by the flames. She is as still as stone, a chilling silhouette amidst the raging inferno.

Your gaze locks with the witch's, and you find yourself entrapped by her stare. Her eyes, gleaming coals in the firelight, seem to bore into your very soul.

Was it your imagination, or has she been staring at you all along?

## Wrath of the Righteous
Chave: `resources.assets:2545778` — GUID: `5c2dd0f8-93c0-47f3-b621-0b8f0d42f50f`
Categoria: Normal — raridade: Common (0) — peso relativo: 1.0
Origem: events/wrath of the righteous - part 2 — SHA objeto: `4c78b8a43950e25d85b594ad5dde686b77df42fc84daa4588e2b3f10411ff9b8`

### Texto original
Through the arched passageways and shadowed halls of this castle, you find yourself standing before a figure who appears to be hewn from radiance itself. A <gold><b><incr>Paladin</incr></b></gold>, clad in armor of brilliant light, that casts the dreary surroundings into stark relief. His presence is a beacon of hope in the midst of such an accursed place.

"This kingdom," he begins, gesturing to the darkened tapestries and ominous statues lining the corridors, "was once a place of joy, a place where valor met prosperity and nobility met humility. But now..." His gaze falls, his expression sorrowful. The luminous light surrounding him seems to dim, the sadness is almost palpable. "Now, this castle is but a mockery of its past, its people cursed, its glory lost."

"At the heart of it all is <rainb><b><incr>The Jester</incr></b></rainb>, our former king transformed into a vile demon. He is the embodiment of the darkness that has seeped into the heart of our kingdom, the puppet master who pulls the strings of this grim performance."

His plea resonates in the chilly air, a desperate call to arms. "Will you aid us, adventurer? Will you deliver us from the grip of this monstrous farce, and bring an end to our torment?"
